question: In Formula 1 seasons since 2001, considering only drivers who scored points in a season, which five constructors have had the most seasons where their drivers scored the fewest total points among all point-scoring drivers in that season?
sql:
WITH season_points AS (
    SELECT 
        r.year,
        cs.constructor_id,
        SUM(cs.points) as total_points
    FROM constructor_standings cs
    JOIN races r ON cs.race_id = r.race_id
    WHERE r.year >= 2001
    GROUP BY r.year, cs.constructor_id
),
point_scoring_seasons AS (
    SELECT 
        year,
        constructor_id,
        total_points
    FROM season_points
    WHERE total_points > 0
),
min_points_per_season AS (
    SELECT 
        year,
        MIN(total_points) as min_points
    FROM point_scoring_seasons
    GROUP BY year
),
lowest_constructors AS (
    SELECT 
        pss.year,
        pss.constructor_id,
        pss.total_points
    FROM point_scoring_seasons pss
    JOIN min_points_per_season mps ON pss.year = mps.year AND pss.total_points = mps.min_points
)
SELECT 
    c.name,
    lc.constructor_id,
    COUNT(*) as seasons_with_lowest_points
FROM lowest_constructors lc
JOIN constructors c ON lc.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
GROUP BY lc.constructor_id, c.name
ORDER BY seasons_with_lowest_points DESC
LIMIT 5
